mapper.select: select status,response_json,created_at, (created_at < utc_timestamp() - interval #{ttlMinutes} minute) stale from sys_idempotency_record where idempotency_key=#{key} and user_id=#{userId} and operation=#{operation}
mapper.update: update sys_idempotency_record set status='FAILED' where idempotency_key=#{key} and user_id=#{userId} and operation=#{operation}
update sys_idempotency_record set status='COMPLETED',response_json=#{responseJson} where idempotency_key=#{key} and user_id=#{userId} and operation=#{operation}
mapper.delete: delete from sys_idempotency_record where idempotency_key=#{key} and user_id=#{userId} and operation=#{operation}
